title: Kiehl’s and Lea Michele spotlight NYC’s local businesses in Christmas campaign
summary: The partnership sees skin care brand Kiehl’s partner with Glee star Lea Michele to encourage consumers to ‘Gift Like a Local’ as it celebrates local businesses across New York, US

extraction.key_fact: 키엘이 배우 리아 미셸과 함께 뉴욕 지역 상점을 조명하는 크리스마스 캠페인을 벌인다.
